name: Deluxe Kit
description: The most complete pen plating kit available. Covers the full range: Absorbent, Nickel, Gold 24K, Silver, Chrome Color, and Copper.
metaTitle: Electroplating Pen Kit | 6 Plating Pens + Power Supply
metaDescription: Hunter Products Deluxe Kit: power supply, cables, and six Micro-Metallizer pens (Absorbent, Nickel, Gold 24K, Silver, Chrome Color, Copper). Ships from NJ. Order direct from the manufacturer.
specs: Absorbent, Nickel, Gold 24K, Silver, Chrome Color, Copper
longDescription:
The Deluxe Kit is Hunter Products' most comprehensive Micro-Metallizer pen plating package. It bundles every pen needed to handle the full standard range of plating work — from prep through final finish — alongside the variable DC power supply and connector cables required to drive the system.

Every component is shipped from our Flemington, NJ facility and is the same hardware deployed in aerospace MRO shops, dental laboratories, research labs, and electronics repair facilities. The pens are self-contained, disposable cartridges: no tank prep, no plating bath, no hazardous waste handling.

This kit is the right starting point for any shop bringing portable spot-plating capability in-house for the first time, or for replacing an existing tank-based workflow with something faster and more selective. Heavy-duty equivalents are available individually if you need thicker deposits.

name: Deluxe Kit (Heavy Duty)
description: Premium heavy-duty complete kit. Silver-Heavy, Copper-Heavy, Gold 24K-Heavy, Nickel-Heavy, Rhodium, and Absorbent pens included.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty Electroplating Pen Kit | 6 HD Pens + Power Supply
metaDescription: Heavy-duty complete plating kit with six high-volume HD pens: Silver, Copper, Gold 24K, Nickel, Rhodium, Absorbent — plus the Micro-Metallizer power supply. Ships from Flemington, NJ.
specs: HD power supply + cables + 6 heavy-duty pens
Absorbent, Nickel HD, Gold 24K HD, Silver HD, Copper HD, Rhodium
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty Deluxe Kit is engineered for shops that plate at industrial volume. Each pen carries significantly more electrolyte per cartridge than the standard pens, allowing for thicker deposits and longer runs between cartridge changes — critical when plating wear surfaces, large-area contacts, or production-volume restoration work.

The kit includes the heavy-duty pens for the five most commonly plated metals (Gold 24K, Silver, Copper, Nickel, Rhodium) plus the Absorbent / Degreaser pen for surface preparation. The accompanying Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables complete the system.

Recommended for aerospace MRO, dental and surgical instrument restoration, industrial component repair, and any operation where the standard pens would require frequent cartridge replacement. The pens included here are also sold individually for replenishment.

name: Contact Repair Kit
description: Complete repair kit for electronic component restoration. Includes power supply, connector cables, Absorbent, Nickel, and 24K Gold pen.
h1: Gold Plating Pen Kit for Contact Repair
metaTitle: Gold Plating Pen Kit for Contact Repair | Gold, Nickel & Power Supply
metaDescription: Targeted kit for restoring worn or corroded electrical contacts. Power supply, cables, plus Absorbent, Nickel, and 24K Gold Micro-Metallizer pens. Direct from Hunter Products.
longDescription:
The Contact Repair Kit is the focused subset of the Micro-Metallizer system used by electronics technicians, aerospace MRO crews, and avionics repair shops to restore conductivity to worn or corroded electrical contacts.

The three pens in the kit — Absorbent (for cleaning the contact surface), Nickel (as an underlayer), and Gold 24K (as the final conductive layer) — execute the standard contact-restoration sequence on copper-based connectors, edge connectors, switch contacts, and connector pins.

This kit is significantly more cost-effective than the Deluxe Kit if your work is centered on electrical contact repair rather than general-purpose plating. The Heavy Duty version is available for shops doing higher-volume restoration work.

name: Contact Repair Kit (Heavy Duty)
description: Heavy-duty version for thicker substrates. Includes HD power supply, cables, and heavy-duty Absorbent, Nickel, and Gold pens.
h1: Heavy-Duty Gold Plating Pen Kit for Contact Repair
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty Gold Plating Pen Kit | HD Gold & Nickel Pens
metaDescription: Heavy-duty contact restoration kit: power supply, cables, plus HD Absorbent, Nickel, and 24K Gold pens for thicker deposits on production-volume electrical repair.
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty Contact Repair Kit pairs the same three-pen contact-restoration workflow with the heavy-duty pen cartridges, which carry more electrolyte and allow for thicker gold and nickel deposits per session.

For electronics manufacturers and MRO shops handling production-volume contact restoration — switch banks, multi-pin connectors, edge connectors at scale — the HD pens significantly reduce cartridge swap frequency and total cost per repair compared to the standard kit.

Includes the variable DC Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables required for operation. Refills are sold individually if a single pen runs out before the others.

name: Absorbent / Degreaser Pen
description: Essential first step in any plating process. Cleans and degreases all metal surfaces (except stainless steel) before plating.
h1: Absorbent / Degreaser Pen for Plating Prep
metaTitle: Absorbent / Degreaser Plating Pen | Micro-Metallizer | Hunter Products
metaDescription: The Absorbent / Degreaser pen prepares metal surfaces for plating — required first step before any Micro-Metallizer plating pen. For all metals except stainless steel.
specs: Surface cleaning and degreasing prior to plating
longDescription:
The Absorbent / Degreaser pen is the mandatory first step in any Micro-Metallizer plating workflow. It removes oils, oxides, and surface contaminants that would otherwise prevent the plating layer from bonding correctly to the substrate.

Used across every Hunter Products kit, the pen handles all common substrates — copper, brass, nickel, steel, gold, silver — with the single exception of stainless steel, which requires the specialized Stainless Steel Degreaser Pen (PL-1014) instead.

Requires the Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables. If you are buying individual pens to assemble a custom kit, start with this pen plus the metal you intend to plate.

name: Gold 24K Plating Pen
description: Plate pure 24-karat gold onto gold, nickel, or silver surfaces. Ideal for connector pins, edge connectors, and switch contacts.
metaTitle: 24K Gold Plating Pen | Electroplating Pen for Contacts & Connectors
metaDescription: Plate pure 24-karat gold onto gold, nickel, or silver surfaces with the Micro-Metallizer pen. Used for connector pin, edge connector and switch contact repair.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The 24K Gold Plating Pen deposits pure 24-karat gold for both functional and decorative applications. For electrical contact work — connector pins, edge connectors, switch contacts — pure gold delivers the highest conductivity and corrosion resistance available, which is why this pen is a staple of aerospace MRO and electronics restoration shops.

The same pen handles prototype contacts, lab samples, and touch-up on gold-plated parts where a full tank dip is impractical. It plates onto gold, silver, or nickel substrates.

Requires surface preparation with the Absorbent / Degreaser pen first. On copper or other non-compatible substrates, apply a nickel underlayer with the Nickel Plating Pen (PL-1006) before plating gold. Heavy-duty variant available as the Gold 24K Heavy Duty Pen (PL-1016).

name: Gold 18K Plating Pen
description: Plate 18K gold onto gold, silver, or nickel for a harder-wearing finish than 24K on high-contact parts.
metaTitle: 18K Gold Plating Pen | Durable Gold for High-Contact Parts
metaDescription: Plate 18-karat gold for a harder-wearing finish than 24K on high-contact industrial components. Compatible with gold, silver, or nickel surfaces. Micro-Metallizer pen system.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The 18K Gold Plating Pen deposits 18-karat gold, a harder-wearing finish than pure 24K, for high-contact industrial components and touch-up on existing 18K-plated parts.

The Micro-Metallizer pen format makes it possible to selectively plate small features without immersing the entire part in a plating bath.

Requires Absorbent / Degreaser pen for surface prep. On non-gold/silver/nickel substrates, apply Nickel underlayer first. Heavy-duty variant (PL-1017) is available for higher-volume operations.

name: Gold 14K Plating Pen
description: Plate 14K gold over gold, silver, or nickel surfaces for gold-alloy touch-up.
metaTitle: 14K Gold Plating Pen | Gold-Alloy Touch-Up
metaDescription: 14-karat gold plating pen for gold-alloy touch-up. Spot-plate over gold, silver, or nickel surfaces with the portable Micro-Metallizer system. Ships from NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The 14K Gold Plating Pen deposits 14-karat gold over gold, silver, or nickel. It is used for touch-up on existing 14K-plated parts where the color needs to match, and where a harder finish than pure 24K is preferred.

The Micro-Metallizer pen format eliminates the time and chemical handling overhead of tank plating for repair-volume work.

Requires Absorbent / Degreaser for prep. Apply Nickel as an intermediate layer on non-compatible substrates.

name: Nickel Plating Pen
description: Plate nickel over copper surfaces. Apply copper flash first on non-copper substrates. Essential underlayer for many plating sequences.
metaTitle: Nickel Plating Pen | Electroplating Underlayer for Gold & Rhodium
metaDescription: Plate nickel onto copper surfaces — the standard underlayer for gold and rhodium plating. Micro-Metallizer pen format. Ships from Hunter Products, Flemington NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Nickel Plating Pen is one of the most-used pens in the Micro-Metallizer system. Beyond standalone nickel plating, it serves as the standard underlayer that gives gold, rhodium, and other precious-metal platings the durable, well-bonded substrate they require.

Electrical contact restoration workflows (PL-1000C kit) typically apply nickel as an intermediate before the final gold layer. The same workflow is used for connector pin and edge-connector repair across electronics and aerospace MRO.

Apply over copper directly. For other substrates (steel, brass, etc.), apply a copper flash with the Copper Plating Pen first. Heavy-duty variant (PL-1020) available.

name: Black Nickel Plating Pen
description: Deposit black nickel for decorative and functional applications. Apply copper flash first on non-copper surfaces.
metaTitle: Black Nickel Plating Pen | Non-Reflective Black Finish
metaDescription: Black nickel plating pen for decorative or low-reflectivity functional finishes. Plates over copper substrates with the Micro-Metallizer system. Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Black Nickel Plating Pen deposits a dark, low-reflectivity nickel finish used for decorative applications (firearms, instruments, fittings) and for functional applications where surface reflectivity needs to be suppressed (optical instruments, camera components).

The pen is a drop-in alternative to the standard Nickel pen where the visual finish matters. Workflow is identical: apply over copper directly, or apply a copper flash first when working on steel, brass, or other substrates.

Requires Absorbent / Degreaser for prep, plus the Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables.

name: Silver Plating Pen
description: Plate silver onto any metallic surface except aluminum or chromium. Common for electrical contacts and silverware restoration.
metaTitle: Silver Plating Pen | Electroplating Pen for Silverware & Contacts
metaDescription: Spot-plate silver onto most metals — for electrical contacts and silverware repair. Portable Micro-Metallizer pen. Direct from Hunter Products.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Silver Plating Pen restores silver on antique silverware, plates fresh silver on electrical contacts where high conductivity is required.

Unlike many of the other pens, the Silver pen will plate directly onto most metallic substrates without an intermediate layer — the two exceptions being aluminum and chromium, which require different surface chemistry the Micro-Metallizer system does not address.

For silverware restoration, expect to use multiple cartridges per piece on larger items — the Silver Heavy Duty Pen (PL-1018) is the more economical choice once volume justifies it.

name: Chrome Color Plating Pen
description: Apply a chrome-colored finish over copper. Apply copper flash first on non-copper surfaces.
metaTitle: Chrome Color Plating Pen | Chrome-Look Touch-Up Finish
metaDescription: Apply a bright chrome-colored decorative finish over copper substrates with the Micro-Metallizer Chrome Color pen. For restoration and decorative work. Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Chrome Color Plating Pen deposits a bright, chrome-like decorative finish — used for restoration of automotive trim, decorative hardware, instrument bezels, and similar visual-finish applications.

This is a chrome-COLORED finish optimized for portable spot plating; it is not equivalent to industrial hard chrome plating. For decorative restoration and selective re-finishing, however, it allows touch-up work that would otherwise require sending a part out to a plating shop.

Plates directly over copper. For other substrates, apply a copper flash with the Copper Plating Pen (PL-1010) before the chrome color layer.

name: Copper Plating Pen
description: Plate copper over any metallic surface (not aluminum or chromium). Used as an intermediate flash layer for other platings.
metaTitle: Copper Plating Pen | Copper Flash for Steel & Brass
metaDescription: Copper plating pen for the Micro-Metallizer system — used as a flash layer beneath other platings or for direct copper conductive surfaces. Hunter Products, Flemington NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Copper Plating Pen plays two roles in the Micro-Metallizer system. First, as a standalone deposit for restoring copper conductive surfaces (busbars, contact rails, antique copperware). Second — and more commonly — as the intermediate flash layer that lets you build up other plating sequences on substrates that wouldn't normally accept them directly (steel, brass, etc.).

The standard workflow for plating chrome, nickel, or rhodium onto a non-copper part is: degrease → copper flash with this pen → target metal. For thicker copper buildup on industrial parts, use the Copper Heavy Duty Pen (PL-1019) instead.

Plates over most metals with the two exceptions of aluminum and chromium. Requires Absorbent / Degreaser pen for surface prep.

name: Rhodium Plating Pen
description: Premium rhodium plating for the hardest, most reflective finish available. Plate over nickel — apply copper flash and nickel first on non-copper surfaces.
metaTitle: Rhodium Plating Pen | Hard, Wear-Resistant Reflective Finish
metaDescription: Rhodium plating pen — the hardest, most reflective finish in the Micro-Metallizer system. Used for optical components, premium contacts, and hard wear surfaces.
specs: Nickel (apply copper + nickel flash on others)
Absorbent Pen, Nickel Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Rhodium Plating Pen produces the hardest, brightest, and most tarnish-resistant finish available across the Micro-Metallizer pen lineup. Used in industrial applications calling for an extremely hard, reflective surface: optical components, premium electrical contacts, and instrument work.

Rhodium is the most expensive of the standard plating metals, which is reflected in this pen's price. For shops doing high-volume rhodium work, replenishment cartridges should be ordered ahead of need.

Requires a nickel underlayer in nearly all cases. On non-copper substrates, the full sequence is: degrease → copper flash → nickel → rhodium.

name: Tin Plating Pen
description: Plate tin over any metallic surface (not aluminum or chromium). Widely used in electronics for solderability enhancement.
metaTitle: Tin Plating Pen | Re-Tin PCB Pads & Restore Solderability
metaDescription: Tin plating pen — restore or apply tin coatings for solderability on PCBs, leads, and component pads. Micro-Metallizer pen system. Hunter Products, Flemington NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Tin Plating Pen is primarily an electronics-industry tool, used to restore or apply tin coatings on PCB pads, component leads, terminals, and lugs to keep them solderable. Old or oxidized tin surfaces become difficult to wet with solder; selectively re-plating with this pen restores normal soldering behavior without reworking the entire board.

Also used outside electronics for general corrosion protection on copper, brass, and steel components that would oxidize too quickly otherwise.

Plates directly over most metals; aluminum and chromium are the two exceptions. Requires Absorbent / Degreaser pen for surface preparation.

name: Zinc Plating Pen
description: Plate zinc over metallic surfaces for corrosion protection and galvanic applications (not aluminum or chromium).
metaTitle: Zinc Plating Pen | Zinc Touch-Up for Steel Corrosion
metaDescription: Zinc plating pen for corrosion protection on steel and other metals — touch-up galvanized coatings, protect fasteners, restore zinc finishes. Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Zinc Plating Pen handles corrosion-protection work on steel and other ferrous components. Touch up scratched or worn galvanized finishes, plate exposed steel fasteners, and re-coat zinc surfaces that have lost their protective layer over time.

Zinc functions as a sacrificial coating — it corrodes preferentially to the steel underneath, extending the substrate's service life. The Micro-Metallizer pen format makes it practical to spot-repair zinc coatings in the field, where dipping the entire part is not an option.

Apply over most metals; aluminum and chromium are the two non-compatible substrates. Requires Absorbent / Degreaser for surface prep.

name: Palladium Plating Pen
description: Plate palladium for corrosion-resistant, tarnish-proof finishes. Widely used in electronics as a white-metal alternative to rhodium.
metaTitle: Palladium Plating Pen | White-Metal Electroplating Pen
metaDescription: Palladium plating pen — tarnish-resistant white-metal finish for electronics and connectors. A cost-effective alternative to rhodium. Hunter Products Micro-Metallizer system.
specs: Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Palladium Plating Pen produces a tarnish-resistant white-metal finish often used as a cost-effective alternative to rhodium where the very-bright rhodium reflectivity isn't required.

Used in electronics for premium contact plating (palladium-nickel sequences are common in connector manufacturing). Palladium's chemistry is more forgiving than rhodium's: it plates onto most metals directly, simplifying the workflow.

Requires Absorbent / Degreaser pen for prep, plus the Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables.

name: Gold 24K Heavy Duty Pen
description: Heavy-duty 24K gold pen for thicker gold deposits on high-wear surfaces. Greater plating volume per cartridge than the standard pen.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty 24K Gold Plating Pen | Thicker Gold Deposits
metaDescription: Heavy-duty 24K gold plating pen for thicker deposits on high-wear contacts. Micro-Metallizer system. Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Heavy Duty — higher volume per cartridge
Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty 24K Gold Pen carries significantly more electrolyte per cartridge than the standard Gold 24K pen (PL-1003), allowing for thicker deposits and longer runs between cartridge swaps.

For production-volume contact restoration (aerospace MRO, switch-bank refurbishment, multi-pin connector repair) the HD pen is significantly more economical per plated job once volume justifies it.

Follow the same workflow as the standard pen: Absorbent / Degreaser first, Nickel underlayer on non-compatible substrates, then plate.

name: Gold 18K Heavy Duty Pen
description: Heavy-duty 18K gold pen for thicker deposits. Ideal for high-contact industrial components requiring a durable gold finish.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty 18K Gold Plating Pen | Thicker Deposits on High-Wear Parts
metaDescription: Heavy-duty 18K gold plating pen — thicker deposits for high-contact industrial components requiring a durable warm-tone gold finish. Hunter Products.
specs: Heavy Duty — higher volume per cartridge
Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty 18K Gold Pen is the standard-pen equivalent (PL-1004) scaled up for higher-volume work on industrial components requiring a durable warm-tone gold finish.

Thicker deposit capability extends wear life on contacts and surfaces that are handled or mated repeatedly.

Workflow is identical to the standard pen: degrease, apply nickel underlayer if needed, plate. Power supply and connector cables required.

name: Silver Heavy Duty Pen
description: Heavy-duty silver pen for thicker silver deposits on electrical contacts, silverware restoration, and other large surfaces.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty Silver Plating Pen | Silverware & Large Contacts | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Heavy-duty silver plating pen — thicker silver deposits for silverware restoration, large electrical contacts. Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Heavy Duty — higher volume per cartridge
Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty Silver Pen is the workhorse for silverware restoration — large surface areas (trays, serving pieces, tea sets) consume electrolyte at a rate that makes the standard Silver pen (PL-1008) impractical.

Also used for large-area electrical contact plating in industrial switchgear and busbar applications, where standard-pen capacity would require frequent cartridge swaps.

Silver plates directly onto most substrates without an intermediate layer; only aluminum and chromium require alternative chemistry. Requires Absorbent / Degreaser pen for surface preparation.

name: Copper Heavy Duty Pen
description: Heavy-duty copper pen for thick copper plating and buildup applications. Ideal as a heavy flash layer on large industrial parts.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty Copper Plating Pen | Thick Flash Layer | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Heavy-duty copper plating pen — thick copper buildup for industrial flash layers and large surface coverage. Micro-Metallizer system. Hunter Products, Flemington NJ.
specs: Heavy Duty — higher volume per cartridge
Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty Copper Pen handles industrial flash-layer work on large surface areas, plus standalone copper buildup applications where the standard Copper pen (PL-1010) would deplete too quickly.

Common use cases: building up a heavy copper flash on large steel parts before applying nickel or chrome; restoring copper busbars; commercial-volume contact-rail repair.

Apply over most metals except aluminum and chromium. Surface preparation with Absorbent / Degreaser is required.

name: Nickel Heavy Duty Pen
description: Heavy-duty nickel pen for thick nickel deposits. Used as a heavy underlayer for gold, rhodium, and other precious metal platings.
metaTitle: Heavy-Duty Nickel Plating Pen | Heavy Underlayer | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Heavy-duty nickel plating pen for thick nickel deposits — the standard heavy underlayer for production gold and rhodium plating. Hunter Products Micro-Metallizer.
specs: Heavy Duty — higher volume per cartridge
Absorbent Pen, Power Supply, Connector Cables
longDescription:
The Heavy Duty Nickel Pen is the production-grade equivalent of the standard Nickel pen (PL-1006). Most often used to lay down the thicker nickel underlayer required for production-volume gold or rhodium plating sequences.

Also used for standalone nickel build-up applications — restoring worn nickel coatings on machinery components, plating contact surfaces, and corrosion-protection touch-up on industrial equipment.

Apply over copper directly; use the Copper Heavy Duty Pen (PL-1019) for a flash layer on steel, brass, and other non-copper substrates.

name: Stainless Steel Degreaser Pen
description: Specialized degreaser for stainless steel surfaces prior to plating. Standard degreaser cannot prep stainless — this is the correct solution.
metaTitle: Stainless Steel Degreaser Pen | Plating Prep | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Specialized Micro-Metallizer degreaser pen for stainless steel — the standard Absorbent pen cannot prep stainless. Required first step when plating stainless substrates.
specs: Surface prep specifically for stainless steel
longDescription:
Stainless steel does not respond to the standard Absorbent / Degreaser pen (PL-1002). Its surface chemistry — passivation layer, chromium content — requires a specialized degreaser, which this pen provides.

Used before any plating work on stainless steel substrates: medical instruments, food-service equipment, marine hardware, and industrial components built from stainless. After this prep, follow with the appropriate plating pen for the target finish.

Requires the Micro-Metallizer power supply and connector cables. This pen is purely a prep step — it does not deposit any plating layer itself.

name: Connector Cables
description: Replacement connector cables for attaching Micro-Metallizer pens to the power supply.
metaTitle: Micro-Metallizer Connector Cables | Replacement Set | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Replacement connector cables for the Micro-Metallizer power supply — connects any plating pen to the power source. Compatible with all Hunter Products power supplies.
specs: Connect Micro-Metallizer pens to power supply
longDescription:
Standard replacement connector cables for the Micro-Metallizer pen plating system. The cables connect any plating pen — standard or heavy duty — to the variable DC power supply (PL-1000).

Included with all kits (Deluxe, Contact Repair, Heavy Duty equivalents) and with the standalone Power Supply purchase. This SKU is purely for replacement when an existing cable wears out or becomes damaged.

Compatible with the full Micro-Metallizer power supply range, current and legacy.

name: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/8"
description: Standard 1/8" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 system. Supplied with the system; used for general-purpose deposition.
metaTitle: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/8" | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Standard 1/8" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 diamond-dusting system. General-purpose deposition. Direct replacement from Hunter Products.
longDescription:
The 1/8" tungsten-carbide electrode is the general-purpose electrode supplied with every new Carbitron 300 diamond-dusting system. It handles the majority of standard tungsten-carbide deposition work — edge hardening, surface coating on medical instruments, tooling, and industrial components.

Electrodes are consumables: they wear down with deposition use and need to be replaced periodically. This SKU is for direct replacement when the original 1/8" electrode from the kit reaches end of service life.

For finer-detail work, see the 1/16" electrode (TS3039); for precision work on small or delicate surfaces, the 1/32" electrode (TS3040).

name: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/16"
description: Fine 1/16" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 system. Supplied with the system; used for finer work on smaller surfaces.
metaTitle: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/16" | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Fine 1/16" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 diamond-dusting system. For finer work on smaller surfaces. Hunter Products replacement.
longDescription:
The 1/16" tungsten-carbide electrode is the fine-detail electrode for the Carbitron 300 system. Used on smaller features where the 1/8" electrode's coverage area is too coarse — dental instrument edges, small surgical tools, precision tooling.

The smaller cross-section also concentrates the deposition current, producing a slightly different deposit profile that some applications require.

Like all Carbitron 300 electrodes, this is a consumable item replaced periodically as it wears down with use.

name: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/32"
description: Precision 1/32" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 system. For precision applications on small or delicate surfaces.
metaTitle: Tungsten-Carbide Electrode 1/32" | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Precision 1/32" × 2½" tungsten-carbide electrode for the Carbitron 300 system — for delicate surfaces and the finest detail work. Hunter Products replacement.
longDescription:
The 1/32" tungsten-carbide electrode is the precision electrode in the Carbitron 300 lineup. Reserved for delicate surfaces, fine-feature deposition, and applications where the larger electrodes would cover too much area or damage adjacent features.

Common use cases include precision dental instrument hardening, micro-tooling edge deposition, and selective coating of delicate medical instruments.

Replacement electrode for the Carbitron 300 system. Like the other electrodes in the family, it is a consumable that wears down with use.

name: Power Supply
description: Variable DC power supply, 110V/60Hz or 220V/50Hz. Drives all Micro-Metallizer plating pens.
metaTitle: Micro-Metallizer Power Supply | Variable DC | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Variable DC power supply for the Micro-Metallizer plating pen system. 110V/60Hz or 220V/50Hz input, 12V DC output. Drives every Hunter Products plating pen.
specs: All Micro-Metallizer pens (standard and heavy duty)
longDescription:
The Micro-Metallizer Power Supply is the variable DC power source that drives the entire Micro-Metallizer pen plating system. It accepts standard 110V/60Hz or 220V/50Hz wall current and outputs the low-voltage DC required for electroplating with the pen cartridges.

Included with every Hunter Products kit (Deluxe, Contact Repair, Heavy Duty equivalents). This standalone listing is for shops building a custom kit from individual pens, or for replacing a damaged or worn supply.

Output is variable, allowing the operator to dial in the right current for each plating sequence. Compatible with the full current and legacy Micro-Metallizer pen range.

name: Vibrator Hand Piece
description: Replacement vibrator hand piece for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide coating system. Hand piece only; power cable not included.
metaTitle: Vibrator Hand Piece TS3042 | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Replacement vibrator hand piece (TS3042) for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide diamond dusting system. Hand piece only. Direct from Hunter Products, NJ.
specs: Hand piece only, no power cable
longDescription:
The vibrator hand piece holds the tungsten-carbide electrode and delivers the deposit to the work surface on the Carbitron 300 system.

This SKU is the hand piece alone, for shops that still have a good power cable and only need to replace the hand piece. If you need the cable as well, order the hand piece with power cable (TS3053).

Accepts all three Carbitron 300 electrodes: 1/8" (TS3038), 1/16" (TS3039) and 1/32" (TS3040).

name: Vibrator Hand Piece with Power Cable
description: Replacement vibrator hand piece with power cable for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide coating system. Ready to connect to the unit.
h1: Vibrator Hand Piece with Power Cable (Carbitron 300)
metaTitle: Vibrator Hand Piece with Cable TS3053 | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Replacement vibrator hand piece with power cable (TS3053) for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide diamond dusting system. Direct from Hunter Products, NJ.
longDescription:
The vibrator hand piece holds the tungsten-carbide electrode and delivers the deposit to the work surface on the Carbitron 300 system. This SKU ships with the power cable attached, so it is a complete replacement for a worn or damaged hand piece assembly.

If your cable is still in good condition, the hand piece alone (TS3042) is also available.

Accepts all three Carbitron 300 electrodes: 1/8" (TS3038), 1/16" (TS3039) and 1/32" (TS3040).

name: Power Cable (Red)
description: Replacement red power cable for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide coating system.
metaTitle: Power Cable (Red) TS3045 | Carbitron 300 | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Replacement red power cable (TS3045) for the Carbitron 300 tungsten-carbide diamond dusting system. Direct from Hunter Products, NJ.
longDescription:
Replacement red power cable for the Carbitron 300 system. Order it when the original cable is worn, cut or damaged.

If the hand piece also needs replacing, the vibrator hand piece with power cable (TS3053) comes as a complete assembly.

name: Carbitron 300 System
description: Professional tungsten carbide coating system. The original diamond dusting platform for medical instruments, tooling, and industrial applications.
metaTitle: Carbitron 300 | Tungsten Carbide Diamond Dusting System | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Carbitron 300 — the original tungsten-carbide diamond dusting platform. Edge-hardens medical, dental, and surgical instruments. Invented and built by Hunter Products, NJ.
longDescription:
The Carbitron 300 is the original commercial diamond-dusting platform. Invented by Hunter Products for the medical and dental industries, the system deposits a hard tungsten-carbide layer onto cutting edges and wear surfaces — extending the operational life of surgical instruments, dental tools, and precision cutting equipment.

The system ships complete with three tungsten-carbide electrodes (1/8", 1/16", and 1/32") covering the range from general-purpose deposition to precision detail work. Electrodes are consumables and are sold individually for replacement.

Deployed across medical instrument manufacturers, dental laboratories, surgical-tool refurbishment shops, precision tooling operations, and industrial cutting applications. For pricing on volume orders, configuration questions, or service support, contact Hunter Products directly.

name: Micro-Jet 200 System
description: Precision micro-abrasive blasting for cleaning, etching, and surface preparation on small or delicate components.
metaTitle: Micro-Jet 200 | Precision Micro-Abrasive Blaster | Hunter Products
metaDescription: Micro-Jet 200 — precision micro-abrasive blasting for cleaning, etching, and surface prep on small or delicate components. Where standard blasting causes damage.
longDescription:
The Micro-Jet 200 is Hunter Products' precision micro-abrasive blasting platform — engineered for cleaning, etching, and surface preparation on parts where conventional blasting equipment is too aggressive.

Used in electronics manufacturing for PCB-level cleaning and rework, in medical instrument production for fine-feature surface prep, in antique and instrument restoration for selective material removal, and in tooling for matte-finish creation on cutting surfaces.

The system controls particle delivery to a degree that allows the operator to work on delicate features — fine wires, thin substrates, intricate detail — without the collateral damage standard blasting would cause. For pricing on volume orders, configuration questions, or service support, contact Hunter Products directly.
